dsh-feed is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Cross-ecosystem aggregation data layer: syncs the GitHub dsh-plugin topic and the npm registry into one open JSON index, queried by model tools, a CLI, and a minimal stdio MCP server.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9ab036e52e32c3ba57da.html
